# Tommy Ooi Travel Guide

> > Personal travel guide featuring hotel reviews, dining experiences, and destination guides across Asia, Europe, and beyond with a focus on luxury stays and culinary adventures.

Tommy Ooi shares detailed travel experiences with emphasis on hotel loyalty programs (particularly Accor Platinum), festive dining events, and practical trip planning guides across destinations including Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Osaka, Tokyo, and European cities.

## Key Topics

- Accor Platinum benefits
- Hotel reviews and luxury stays
- Bangkok dining and hotels
- Kuala Lumpur hotels and restaurants
- Chinese New Year festive dining
- Singapore attractions
- Osaka and Tokyo travel
- Southeast Asia destinations
- European medieval villages
- Budget travel planning
- Travel tips and tourist traps
- Hotel loyalty programs
- Buffet and set menu reviews
- Heritage boutique hotels
- Yogyakarta accommodations
